title: MENS Cloud Training Economics (surveyed 2026-09-11)
summary: Survey of 18 GPU rental providers (on-demand/spot pricing, billing granularity, SLAs) for 27-32B QLoRA; ranks by fitness for this job size; recommends local default with RunPod Secure as contingency.
notes: Research document with measured pricing and verified uptime SLAs. Status=research (not current), marked training_eligible=false. Provides data for decision-making but doesn't itself decide. Includes gotchas (egress dominates bill, storage billing on stop) and gap disclosures.
